Product Description
About This Item
[Fast Installation & Setup] - As Easy As Replacing A Light Bulb To Install The Light Bulb Camera, And Set Up Via Upgrade Wi-Fi Mode
Within 3 Minutes. Simple To Control, And A Breeze To Maintain. Compatible With 2.4GHz/SGHz WiFI Network
The Maximum WiFi Signal Reception Range Of The Bulb Camera Is 10 Meters. Please Install It As Close To The WiFi Router As Possible
[355° Motion Detection) - Automatically Senses And The Action In Your Indoor In 355° PTZ Technology. Security Cam Has Wide Field of
View - Rotates 355° Horizontally And 120° Vertically. Pan/Tilt/Zoom/Light/Talk/Playback Easily With The App, Whenever And Wherever.
Please Note: The Maximum Horizontal Rotation Angle Of The Bulb Security Camera Is 355 Degrees, Not 360 Degrees Cyclically.
[Real-time Alert & 2-Way Talk] - Motion Alerts Will Be Sent To Your Device While You're Away To Keep You Informed Of Every Potential
Danger At Your Home. You Can Work With Peace Of Mind By Bulb Camera WiFi Indoor, Which Allows You To Keep In Touch With Your Family
Or Pets Anywhere Anytime With Built-in Speaker.
[1080P FHD & Color Night Vision) - 1080P Full HD Security Camera Provides Crystal Clear Videos And Recordings. Quality Infrared LEDs
& Sensor Extend The Range Of Night Vision Reach Up To 33 Ft, Lets You See Everything Clearly Even In The Dark, And The Lights Turn On
Automatically When You Are Coming.
[Multi-device Sharing & Multi-view] - You Can Share Your Cameras With Family, Friends And Other Devices So That You Can All Access
Them Simultaneously.
[Video Privacy Guarantee) - Video And Accounts Are Encrypted Using A Unique Encryption Technology To Save Video On Micro SD Card
(Not Included) Or Cloud. Even If Your Camera Light Bulb Or SD Card Is Stolen, The Video Files In The SD Card Can Only Be Accessed In Your
Own Account. Maintain The Security Of Your Home And Keep Your Data And Privacy Secure.
[Any Questions About Connection, Installation, Functionality Or More, Please Feel Free To Contact Us. We
sincerely Provide You With Lifetime Technical Support And Service.]
